archetype: LUXURY NOIR & GOLD SAAS DASHBOARD (High Density & Executive Polish)

design_philosophy.tone: Elegance, Exclusivity, Professionalism, Sophistication, Modernity, Premium Beauty SaaS
design_philosophy.theme_preference: Dark Luxury (Noir #0A0A0C background, Warm Obsidian #121216 surfaces, Brushed Gold/Bronze #D4AF37 accents, Crisp White text)
anti_patterns: No generic Vercel light mode or standard blue SaaS templates
Do NOT turn the UI predominantly pink; rose/pink is strictly a subtle secondary accent for delicate tags or light glows
No full screen flat grey backgrounds — use rich tinted obsidian black with subtle 1px metallic gold/bronze borders
No hidden mobile functionality — tables convert seamlessly into rich responsive glass cards on mobile
No unstyled select/date inputs — use custom styled datepicker/calendar & dropdown components
No transparent sticky headers without backdrop blur

hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white font-serif
hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-widest

branding_logo.description: Circular black emblem with gold/bronze art-deco rim, white NA handwritten monogram center, NAIL'S DESIGNER and M&A STUDIO text on upper and lower arcs.
branding_logo.style: W-10 h-10 or w-12 h-12 rounded-full border border-[#D4AF37]/50 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.2)] bg-black p-1 flex items-center justify-center

grid_modes.mobile_adaptations: Tables hide on mobile (<768px) and switch to stacked luxury cards with gold borders and clear action triggers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app is rich dark noir with metallic gold accents, giving an immediate executive salon software feel.
Implement language state globally (pt-BR, es, en) with language selector available both on the Login screen and top bar.
Ensure all CRUD views (Clientes, Serviços, Profissionais, Pagamentos) have search, filters, modal forms, confirmation dialogs, empty states, loading skeletons, and sonner toasts.
Agenda calendar view should feature Day, Week, and Month view toggles as well as filter by professional and status.
Mobile layout must convert tabular data into card grids with generous tap targets.
Every key action button and input field must feature a distinct data-testid (e.g., data-testid='add-client-btn', data-testid='appointment-submit-btn').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic white backgrounds or plain grey borders.
Ensure interactive state contrast (e.g. hover:bg-[#D4AF37] hover:text-black).
Use framer-motion or subtle CSS transitions for dialogs, drawer sliding on mobile, and stat counts.
All modal triggers must require explicit confirmation when deleting or cancelling records.
